module_summary: AXI-stream to AXI4 write DMA: a 5-state FSM splits descriptors into 4K-safe bursts, aligns stream data, buffers beats in an output FIFO and reports completion via a status FIFO.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Main FSM (IDLE/START/WRITE/FINISH_BURST/DROP_DATA) sequencing descriptor, bursts and data.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_desc_valid
anchors.why: Write descriptor valid; accepted in IDLE to start a DMA operation.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_desc_ready
anchors.why: Descriptor ready, asserted in IDLE when enabled and status slots available.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_data_tdata
anchors.why: Input stream payload, shifted for alignment and written to AXI.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_data_tvalid
anchors.why: Input stream valid; triggers first AW issue and data beats.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_data_tready
anchors.why: Input stream ready computed by FSM from FIFO space and active flags.

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write address valid issued per burst in START state.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data driven from output FIFO register.

anchors.name: m_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: AXI write response valid; pops status FIFO and reports completion.

anchors.name: m_axis_write_desc_status_valid
anchors.why: Descriptor completion status valid, from last flag of status FIFO entry.

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Burst start address loaded from addr_reg.

anchors.name: m_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI write data valid from output FIFO read side.

anchors.name: addr_reg
anchors.why: Current write address; advanced by burst size after each AW issue.

anchors.name: op_word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining bytes of descriptor; decides burst size and more bursts.

anchors.name: input_active_reg
anchors.why: Input stream still delivering data for this burst; gates tready and counters.

anchors.name: last_transfer_reg
anchors.why: Current burst is final of descriptor; controls tready and finish path.

anchors.name: output_last_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Last beat of AXI burst; asserts WLAST and state exit.

anchors.name: status_fifo_len
anchors.why: Status FIFO memory of per-burst length (with tag/id/dest/user/last arrays).

anchors.name: status_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Status FIFO write pointer, advanced when burst status enqueued.

anchors.name: out_fifo_wdata
anchors.why: Output write-data FIFO decoupling FSM beats from AXI W channel.

anchors.name: status_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Status FIFO read pointer, advanced on each B response.

anchors.name: out_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Output FIFO write pointer, increments on m_axi_wvalid_int.

anchors.name: out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Output FIFO read pointer, increments when W beat loaded.

anchors.name: out_fifo_half_full_reg
anchors.why: Output FIFO half-full; deasserts internal write ready.

anchors.name: m_axi_wready_int
anchors.why: Internal ready from output FIFO back-pressuring FSM data beats.

anchors.name: m_axi_wvalid_int
anchors.why: FSM beat write enable into output FIFO.

anchors.name: m_axi_wready
anchors.why: AXI W ready; pops output FIFO into W registers.

anchors.name: m_axi_awready
anchors.why: AXI AW ready clearing awvalid.

anchors.name: m_axi_bready
anchors.why: B ready asserted while status FIFO has pending entries.

anchors.name: status_fifo_we
anchors.why: Enqueue enable for status FIFO at burst end.

anchors.name: transfer_in_save
anchors.why: Load enable for saved stream word used by alignment shifter.

anchors.name: flush_save
anchors.why: Clears saved partial word and extra-cycle flag in IDLE.

anchors.name: shift_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Aligned stream data combining saved and new words by offset.

anchors.name: shift_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Aligned data valid gating FSM beat processing.

anchors.name: shift_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Aligned end-of-packet; triggers status enqueue and state exit.

anchors.name: shift_axis_input_tready
anchors.why: Shifter can accept input; gates stream tready.

anchors.name: save_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Saved previous stream word for unaligned shift.

anchors.name: shift_axis_extra_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Extra output cycle needed to flush saved bytes at frame end.

anchors.name: offset_reg
anchors.why: Byte offset selecting shift amount for unaligned data.

anchors.name: zero_offset_reg
anchors.why: Selects passthrough vs shifted stream path.

anchors.name: tr_word_count_next
anchors.why: Computed burst byte count limited by max burst and 4K boundary.

anchors.name: input_cycle_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining input stream cycles in current burst.

anchors.name: output_cycle_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining AXI beats in current burst; sets output_last_cycle.

anchors.name: length_reg
anchors.why: Accumulated transferred byte length reported in status.

anchors.name: first_cycle_reg
anchors.why: First cycle of descriptor; adjusts length and AW issue condition.

anchors.name: bresp_reg
anchors.why: Sticky AXI error response mapped to status error code.

anchors.name: tag_reg
anchors.why: Descriptor tag held for status FIFO entries.

anchors.name: active_count_reg
anchors.why: Outstanding burst count limiting in-flight writes to status FIFO depth.

anchors.name: active_count_av_reg
anchors.why: Outstanding slot available; gates descriptor ready and AW issue.

anchors.name: m_axis_write_desc_status_error
anchors.why: DMA error code from AXI SLVERR/DECERR responses.

anchors.name: m_axis_write_desc_status_len
anchors.why: Reported transferred length from status FIFO.

anchors.name: m_axi_awlen
anchors.why: Burst length from output cycle count.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_desc_addr
anchors.why: Descriptor start address loaded into addr_reg.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_desc_len
anchors.why: Descriptor length loaded into op_word_count_reg.

anchors.name: enable
anchors.why: Global enable gating descriptor acceptance.

groups.name: Write DMA controller
groups.description: FSM sequencing descriptor load, burst issue, data beats, burst finish and drop.

groups.name: Descriptor and burst address generator
groups.description: Accepts descriptors, splits into 4K-safe bursts and drives AXI AW channel.

groups.name: Beat and length counters
groups.description: Input/output cycle counters and accumulated length per burst.

groups.name: Stream alignment shifter
groups.description: Combines saved and incoming stream words to realign data to AXI address offset.

groups.name: Output write data FIFO
groups.description: 32-entry FIFO buffering W beats with half-full backpressure to FSM.

groups.name: Completion status FIFO
groups.description: Queues per-burst status, pops on B responses and emits descriptor status with errors.
